findings.location: sources.references Nayak et al. entry, locator field
findings.evidence: The locator names §IV.B.c for Fibonacci fusion, F, and R data. In the cited PDF, the fusion rule and F data are in §IV.B.a, equations (126)–(129); the R phases are in §IV.B.b, equations (132)–(133). Section IV.B.c is the later computation subsection. The URL is correct, and the assigned example now cites the accurate subsections. [Nayak et al., Non-Abelian Anyons and Topological Quantum Computation](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0707.1889).

coverage_note: Opened all 17 assigned items, both assigned pages, three required pages, and the direct dependency carriers listed in the report. Consulted [EGNO](https://math.mit.edu/~etingof/egnobookfinal.pdf), [Penneys](https://people.math.osu.edu/penneys.2/UQSL/ArchivedNotes/TPM/FusionCats.pdf), [Shao](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.00747), [Nayak et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0707.1889), [Bernevig and Neupert](https://math.uniandes.edu.co/~cursillo_gr/escuela2015/abstracts/LectureNotes_LesHouches14_Vietri14_Bogota15_NeupertBernevig.pdf), [Siehler](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0011037), and [Chen](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1502.06845).
